requires.desc: Execution contract with era map and schema v2
Scout gaps used as seed material

invariants.text: All 7 era records exist and validate against the era-record schema: 9 fields non-empty, money-type splits present in SCALE and BUYERS, 5-10 dated events, unit_economics present for eras 5-7.
Every quantitative claim carries the full calibration object; grades in {A,B,C}; grade-C claims carry a method; sources non-empty; claim IDs unique across all eras.
No claim cites the inspiring podcasts (Acquired, Stratechery) as a source; era-1 SCALE contains benchmark-year estimates only, no fabricated annual series.

Records respect the pre-cleared timeline corrections in PLAN.md section 2 (AdWords CPM launch date, Overture revenue lead through 2002, patent settlement, radio never #1, OOH category break, Wanamaker/first-banner flagged as legend unless newly proven). Any evidence-backed contradiction is flagged in the record's notes, not silently dropped.
invariants.instructions: Read each era record and its notes against PLAN.md section 2's correction list. A record that asserts a corrected myth without new primary evidence violates this invariant.

invariants.text: Neighboring eras agree on boundary-shared facts (each record's boundary_notes reconciles with its neighbors).
invariants.instructions: For each era pair (N, N+1), compare boundary_notes and overlapping claims. Disagreements on the same fact (different values outside each other's CIs, contradictory event dates) violate this invariant.

invariants.text: Every scout gap marked blocking or major for an era (planning/unknown-unknowns-probe.json, affected_eras) is either addressed in that era's record or explicitly deferred with a reason in its notes.
invariants.instructions: Filter the probe file's gaps by affected_eras and severity in {blocking, major}. Spot-check each against the era record and notes: addressed, or deferred-with-reason, both pass; ignored fails.
